dedupe_keys.name: data underlying the research of integration of observed and model derived groundwater levels in landslide threshold models in rwanda

description: Data underlying the research of Integration of observed and model derived groundwater levels in landslide threshold models in Rwanda is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by 4TU.ResearchData. This dataset contains landslide inventory and groundwater level data collected from Rwanda. The groundwater data in this dataset were collected from 2016-2021. The landslide inventory contains data from 2006-2021 and was compiled by J.Uwihirwe following the available standard methods and naming adopted by other landslide researchers e.g Monsieurs et al., 2018; Kirschbaum et al., 2009. Coverage: Rwanda. The portal files it under the publisher 4TU.ResearchData. Its tags are Civil Engineering, FOS: Civil engineering, Other Earth Sciences, FOS: Earth and related environmental sciences, Landslide inventory. The repository dates the deposit 2021; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
